audit_items.title: Are signing hashes unique per transaction type (no cross-type collision)?

scope_resolution.reason: This checklist item tests Ethereum Execution Layer (EL) transaction signing mechanisms (EIP-155, EIP-2718 transaction types with prefixes 0x01, 0x02, 0x03, 0x04). The target codebase is Prysm, an Ethereum Consensus Layer (CL/Beacon Chain) implementation. Transaction signing with type prefixes is an EL-only feature not present in CL.

audit_items.notes: Component mismatch: EL feature tested against CL codebase

audit_items.title: Does snapshot mechanism provide true deep-copy isolation?

scope_resolution.reason: This checklist item tests EVM state snapshot mechanisms (begin_transaction, rollback_transaction) with _main_trie and _storage_tries structures. These are EL state management features. Prysm is a CL implementation that does not manage EVM state or transaction snapshots.

audit_items.notes: Component mismatch: EL state management tested against CL codebase

audit_items.title: Does commit_transaction correctly pop both snapshots atomically?

scope_resolution.reason: This checklist item tests EVM transaction commit mechanisms with atomic snapshot popping for both state and transient storage. These are EL-specific state management operations. Prysm (CL) does not implement EVM transaction execution or state snapshots.

audit_items.notes: Component mismatch: EL transaction commit tested against CL codebase

audit_items.title: Does rollback_transaction restore state exactly to snapshot?

scope_resolution.reason: This checklist item tests EVM transaction rollback with REVERT and out-of-gas scenarios, restoring _main_trie and _storage_tries. These are EL state management features related to EVM execution. Prysm (CL) does not execute EVM transactions or manage execution state.

audit_items.notes: Component mismatch: EL rollback mechanism tested against CL codebase

audit_items.title: Is transient storage correctly restored after rollback?

scope_resolution.reason: This checklist item tests EIP-1153 transient storage (TSTORE/TLOAD opcodes) restoration during REVERT operations. Transient storage is an EL EVM feature introduced in the Cancun upgrade. Prysm (CL) does not implement EVM opcodes or transient storage.

audit_items.notes: Component mismatch: EIP-1153 transient storage tested against CL codebase

audit_items.title: Are persistent and transient snapshot stacks always synchronized?

scope_resolution.reason: This checklist item tests synchronization between persistent state and transient storage snapshot stacks during EVM execution. These are EL state management data structures. Prysm (CL) does not maintain snapshot stacks for EVM state.

audit_items.notes: Component mismatch: EL snapshot stacks tested against CL codebase

audit_items.title: Does destroy_account remove both account and storage atomically?

scope_resolution.reason: This checklist item tests SELFDESTRUCT opcode behavior with EIP-6780 constraints, including atomic removal from main trie and storage_tries. SELFDESTRUCT is an EVM opcode and account/storage tries are EL state structures. Prysm (CL) does not implement EVM opcodes or manage account state.

audit_items.notes: Component mismatch: SELFDESTRUCT opcode tested against CL codebase

audit_items.title: Does destroy_storage handle double-deletion safely?

scope_resolution.reason: This checklist item tests edge cases in storage deletion during SELFDESTRUCT operations (double-deletion, KeyError handling). These are EL state management error handling scenarios. Prysm (CL) does not manage EVM storage or implement SELFDESTRUCT.

audit_items.notes: Component mismatch: EL storage deletion tested against CL codebase

audit_items.title: Does get_storage return U256(0) for unset keys?

scope_resolution.reason: This checklist item tests SLOAD opcode behavior for uninitialized storage keys, verifying U256(0) return values. SLOAD is an EVM opcode and storage tries are EL data structures. Prysm (CL) does not implement EVM opcodes or manage contract storage.

audit_items.notes: Component mismatch: SLOAD opcode tested against CL codebase

audit_items.title: Does set_storage assert account exists before writing?

scope_resolution.reason: This checklist item tests SSTORE opcode validation to prevent orphaned storage tries when writing to destroyed accounts. SSTORE is an EVM opcode and storage trie management is an EL concern. Prysm (CL) does not implement EVM opcodes or manage account storage.

audit_items.notes: Component mismatch: SSTORE opcode tested against CL codebase
